children: Mama's Creations, Inc. reported results for the 2026 quarter with revenue of $54.58M and diluted EPS of $0.06, reflecting strong top-line growth and improved profitability versus the prior-year quarter.
¹ Reported as “Net sales”. ² Reported as “Net income”. ³ Reported as “Diluted income per common share”.
Revenue growth was driven by volume gains, new product introductions and the September 2025 acquisition of Crown 1.
Expanded distribution and higher velocities in existing retailers, along with new retail accounts and customers, supported sales momentum.
New product launches and trade/marketing programs accelerated retail velocity and helped secure additional retailer placements.
Higher volumes improved some procurement and overhead efficiencies, although labor, freight and promotional expenses increased.
A significant cash raise strengthened working capital to support scaling of production, marketing and trade programs.
